consult a doctor: If your cough lasts more than two weeks, you should consult a doctor as soon as possible.
如果咳嗽持續超過兩週，你應該盡快看醫生。
consult a dictionary: When you see a word you don't know, try to guess its meaning before you consult a dictionary.
看到不認識的字時，在查字典之前先試著猜猜它的意思。
consult with colleagues: Before making the final decision, the manager consulted with her colleagues to hear their opinions.
在做最後決定前，經理與同事商量，聽聽他們的意見。
consult the map: We got lost in the old town, so we stopped to consult the map on my phone for directions.
我們在老城區迷路了，所以停下來查手機上的地圖找方向。
consume energy: Old air conditioners consume a lot of energy, so replacing them can lower your electricity bill.
舊冷氣消耗大量能源，所以換掉它們可以降低你的電費。
be consumed by guilt: After lying to his best friend, he was consumed by guilt and couldn't sleep for days.
對最好的朋友說謊後，他被罪惡感吞噬，好幾天都睡不著。
consume time: Checking social media can consume a lot of time, so I turn off notifications while I study.
查看社群媒體很耗時，所以我讀書時會關掉通知。
consume food: Americans consume huge amounts of food during Thanksgiving, especially turkey and pumpkin pie.
美國人在感恩節期間吃掉大量食物，尤其是火雞和南瓜派。
consumed with jealousy: When she saw her ex-boyfriend with another girl, she was consumed with jealousy and couldn't stop crying.
看到前男友和別的女生在一起，她妒火中燒，哭個不停。
contain the virus: The government closed the borders in an effort to contain the virus and stop it from spreading.
政府關閉邊境，試圖控制病毒並阻止它擴散。
contain one's anger: Although the customer was very rude, the waiter managed to contain his anger and stayed polite.
雖然那位顧客非常無禮，服務生仍設法壓抑怒氣，保持禮貌。
contain the fire: It took firefighters six hours to contain the fire in the mountains after strong winds spread it.
強風使火勢蔓延後，消防員花了六個小時才控制住山上的火勢。
contain sugar: Many drinks that look healthy actually contain a lot of sugar, so read the labels carefully.
許多看起來健康的飲料其實含糖量很高，所以要仔細閱讀標籤。
contain the crisis: The bank acted quickly to contain the crisis before it could spread to the rest of the economy.
銀行迅速行動以控制危機，以免它擴散到整個經濟。
contaminate the water: Chemicals from the factory contaminated the water in the river, killing thousands of fish.
工廠的化學物質污染了河裡的水源，害死了數千條魚。
contaminate the evidence: The police asked people not to touch anything, because they could contaminate the evidence at the crime scene.
警方要求民眾什麼都別碰，因為他們可能會污染犯罪現場的證據。
contaminated food: Dozens of students got sick after eating contaminated food from the school cafeteria.
數十名學生吃了學校餐廳受污染的食物後生病了。
contemplate the future: Sitting alone on the beach, he began to contemplate the future and what he really wanted in life.
獨自坐在海灘上，他開始思考未來，以及他這輩子真正想要什麼。
contemplate retirement: After working as a teacher for thirty years, Mrs. Lin is starting to contemplate retirement.
當了三十年老師後，林老師開始考慮退休。
contemplate a change: Unhappy with her long working hours, she began to contemplate a change of career.
不滿工作時數太長，她開始考慮改變職業跑道。
contemplate the view: We sat quietly on the mountaintop for an hour, just contemplating the view of the sea of clouds.
我們靜靜地在山頂坐了一個小時，只是凝望著雲海的風景。
contend with problems: As a single mother, she has to contend with many problems, from money to childcare.
身為單親媽媽，她必須應付許多問題，從金錢到照顧孩子都有。
contend for the title: Eight teams from around the world will contend for the title in this year's final tournament.
來自世界各地的八支隊伍將在今年的決賽中爭奪冠軍。
contend that: In the debate, our team will contend that school uniforms should be banned, while the other team argues against it.
在辯論中，我們這隊將主張應該廢除校服，而另一隊則持反對意見。
content oneself with: Since we couldn't afford a trip abroad, we had to content ourselves with a short holiday at home.
既然負擔不起出國旅行，我們只好滿足於在國內短暫度假。
be content with little: My grandmother is content with little; a simple meal and a quiet garden are enough to make her happy.
我的奶奶很知足；一頓簡單的飯和一座安靜的花園就足以讓她快樂。
contented smile: After finishing the delicious meal, the old man leaned back in his chair with a contented smile.
吃完美味的一餐後，老人帶著滿足的微笑靠回椅背。
contest the result: The losing candidate refused to accept defeat and decided to contest the result in court.
落敗的候選人拒絕接受失敗，決定上法院對結果提出異議。
contest an election: She announced that she would contest the election for mayor next year as an independent candidate.
她宣布明年將以無黨籍候選人的身分參選市長。
contest a claim: The company contested the claim that its products were harmful and promised to show scientific proof.
該公司質疑其產品有害的說法，並承諾會提出科學證據。
